Reference productization ladder (honest resume): profile scan FIRST (live: /scan/[scanId]) -> just-pdf -> enrich -> resume (contextual: conversation/interview/meeting-prep/agenda, internal/external/combo; resume-tailor v0.2 + resume-tailor.arcs.care live) -> blueprint + minimum-viable-artifact set -> pre-brief (potential, recoil-prep) -> spark -> de-brief (kinetic, recoil-close). People, process, tools, prints all addressable in the same composition.

content: Pollinate = the horizontal half of the seed lifecycle germinate lacks. Mechanics: (1) POLLEN GATE - strip the instance flesh (PII, tenant specifics) from a seed, keeping only class/invariant + germination conditions; the doll_export fail-closed gate is the existing implementation. (2) SOIL-AGNOSTIC PACKET - receiver re-derives soil/triggers/care for THEIR zero point; sender never prescribes it. (3) CARRIER - wind (public goods broadcast) or bee (hand-sent counterpart note); the carrier never self-sends. (4) PEDIGREE - landed pollen mints a NEW seed in the receiver's bank with dual lineage {parents: [seed-ids across tenants], carrier, landed_ts}; the _SEEDS schema's family/conforms_to fields extend to cross-tenant parentage. (5) OUT-CROSSING RULE - self-pollination is inbreeding depression (author-cosmology echo chamber); a healthy bank shows foreign parentage in its lineage graph.

conforms_to: ADR-068 (print/gate/fate) + sovereign-projection-services (spark plug on prints) + extraction-prospecting (rank from receipts) + magnetic-best-fit-annealing
content: A backlog whose items carry their own topography so plans are INDUCED, not composed. Item schema: jtbd + route (the tool/surface that verifiably reaches it, with verified_date - routes drift) + gates (blocking prints per ADR-068, incl. human-consent gates) + trigger (the spark plug: the precondition that flips it executable - a login appearing, a payment clearing, a reply arriving) + cost_prior (from banked receipts, re-priced by each execution's residue) + fates. Self-fulfilling in three senses: (1) when a trigger flips, execution is mechanical (no session replans it); (2) the sort is gravity (prospecting ranks by cost-receipts); (3) every execution prints receipts that re-price the remaining items - the backlog updates itself from its own residue. Proof instance: the 2026-08-19 Zapier co-pilot SSOT - 8 of 10 items executed across four different executors (inline MCP, browser, workflow agents, human) the moment topology was verified live, zero replanning. NOTOMATION guard: self-fulfilling never means self-authorizing - consent gates (list-first deletion, human sends, judgment calls) stay human even when everything around them is mechanical; the backlog induces execution, never consent.

soil: any open-items list currently living as prose (handoff next-actions, PENDING.md, snapshot.next_action)
triggers: a session picks up _QUEUE/induced-backlog.jsonl and executes an item purely from its stored route+gates without replanning -> the schema works
night-moves or the prospecting pass starts emitting the pull-list against it
care: verify routes live before executing (verify-domain-topology-live class)
every completed item gets a receipt line, every skipped gate is a drift receipt
re-price cost_priors from actuals at close, never re-guess

Inbox-ahead-of-memory = a drift line ('Robin replied Aug-26; memory last records Aug-6'). Optionally sweep calendar for booked events with the counterpart. Output = receipt lines only; judgment (re-warm, close, update) stays human. Proven need 2026-08-26: all three 'stale warm loops' flagged by the archive sweep were wrong in the same pessimistic direction (Robin had closed-warm in writing, Yuri had inverted to reciprocal + booked a 1-1, only Ahmed was truly quiet) because closures and inbounds land in the inbox while memory files sleep.

any session about to act on a loop's staleness (check pulse BEFORE re-warming or closing)

conforms_to: [[inlier-run-the-falsifying-test-before-confident-claim]] (degeneracy only visible in aggregate) + reach-metadata (a tag carries its own reach: source/confidence/informative-or-stub) + [[build-reusable-decomposable-interoperable-default]]
content: Atomic informativeness/degeneracy auditor. Given a tagged corpus, flag signals that are PRESENT but CONTENTLESS - constant across the corpus (<=1 distinct value-tuple), the INLIER class invisible to per-row presence/null checks, visible only in aggregate. Enforces reach-metadata: a categorization's reach must declare informative-vs-stub, not just present-vs-null. Prototype LIVE in run_real_receipts.run() (the corpus-level distinct-value pass); exec-verified on 247 real receipts, where it caught the SAGE somatic/axioms inlier (1 distinct across 45) that presence checks rated 45-real. GERMINATION: extract the corpus pass into a standalone service (records, field-spec) -> per-field {present, distinct, degenerate, informativeness}. Reusable across every ARCS categorization layer (DEWY / NCI / archetypes / Y-gate / operator verdicts) and OSS-able as a general data-quality primitive (a distinct-value/variance pass that catches degenerate-but-present features which pass null-checks). TRIGGER: a second consumer beyond the audit harness.

conforms_to: reach-metadata + JTBD-F (RAG kernel-discovery, unbuilt) + canon-collision-escalate discipline + /catalog (tool-recommender pattern) + [[opposing-abductive-folksonomy-vs-taxonomy-overfit]]
content: The librarian/recommender: proactively surface the nearest EXISTING canon (ADR / axiom / ROM primitive / memory / ledger entry) at the moment of need, BEFORE a mint or a decision, so you consult the map before re-deriving or colliding. The archive (corpus / atlas / ziggurat / canon) is PASSIVE today - it holds the books but has no agency to RECOMMEND them; consultation is manual (grep) or human-prompted. SESSION EVIDENCE (2026-09-02): 4+ near-mints each collided with existing canon (thinking-vs-knowing=Hyperstition#3; premise-law=clarity_before_curvature+Golden-Inchworm; static-regime=Inductive-overfit; deceipt-ledger=falsification-ledger+SUPERSEDED) and each was caught only by manual grep or a human prompt, never by the librarian. The pattern EXISTS for tools (/catalog picks 1 of 131); the CANON analog + GIGI/RAG kernel-discovery (JTBD-F) are unbuilt. COMPANION to informativeness-auditor: the auditor DETECTS what is degenerate in NEW work; the librarian RECOMMENDS what is already-right in the ARCHIVE. GERMINATION: given a candidate claim/mint/decision, return the nearest existing canon with an overlap/collision score - the canon-collision gate made PROACTIVE instead of manual. TRIGGER: the recurring cost of re-derivation/near-collision.

conforms_to: WORLD.md backcountry-avalanche (hidden weak layers = ruin; safe-travel = Y-gate+BAR) + ADR-033 (SUPERSEDED markers, never silent-delete) + reach-metadata + the etymology receipt/deceipt (capere siblings)
content: The ACCOUNTANT: double-entry knowledge bookkeeping WITH a ruin overlay. (1) DOUBLE-ENTRY - receipts=assets (frozen knowing), deceipts=liabilities (false-positives/inliers/discovered-untruths). A discovered-false receipt is MOVED asset->liability (carried, re-examined for pathogen-in-disguise), never silently deleted (extends the falsification ledger + SUPERSEDED discipline into a balance sheet; net epistemic position = assets - liabilities). (2) RUIN OVERLAY - the liabilities RENDER onto the Terrain-Atlas ziggurat as HAZARD markers on the strata they infect, so an ascent is RISK-ADJUSTED by default (the avalanche-forecast layer WORLD.md already specifies but the atlas does not yet render: strata are mapped, weak-layers are not). Completes the triad the auditor and librarian belong to: AUDITOR detects the ruin (informativeness-auditor) -> ACCOUNTANT logs it double-entry AND marks it on the map -> LIBRARIAN recommends the right existing book (canon-recommender). GERMINATION: a ledger with an asset/liability move + an atlas render pass that draws deceipts as weak-layer/hazard glyphs on the ziggurat. TRIGGER: a deceipt discovered (this session: the '45 evidence-backed' - already moved, not deleted, but not yet rendered as a hazard on the map).

conforms_to: read-only static tripwire; PTV-01..07 abstracted from DPRK Contagious Interview (G1052); stdlib-only, no network/exec; exit-code CI gate
content: A read-only scanner that flags malicious install-time/open-time payload triggers in an untrusted repo BEFORE it is opened or installed (the 'opening the folder is the exploit' class). Abstracts the Contagious Interview trigger chain into reusable pattern-threat-vectors: PTV-01 folderOpen task, PTV-02 npm lifecycle hooks, PTV-03 curl|bash, PTV-04 server-driven eval, PTV-05 process.env exfil, PTV-06 obfuscated appended line, PTV-07 known-bad IOC/:1224. Inert by construction (reads files; never installs/execs/evals/networks), so it is safe on the very thing it inspects. Proven on a matched fixture pair (evil exit 2, benign exit 0). Public-good candidate: genuinely useful to any developer/CI independent of ARCS; the ARCS tie-in is the pattern-threat-vector doctrine and the orthogonal-echo lineage (provenance-before-execution invariant).

soil: any dev/CI adding untrusted deps or receiving recruiter/take-home repos; the detection bundle in analysis/detections/ is the live campaign instance
triggers: a second campaign's IOCs get loaded via --iocs -> the abstraction (PTV over literals) proves it generalizes
a full skill-creator eval loop runs the evil/benign fixtures + trigger-optimization -> ready to atomize into a public repo
care: stays read-only and network-free forever; the day it executes what it scans, it becomes the threat
heuristic not sandbox: a clean result never means 'safe', only 'no known pattern fired'
tune PTV-02 for legit husky/build prepare hooks before hard-failing CI

conforms_to: worktree-isolated multi-session fan-out; pre-serialized disjoint write-scope + single-owner shared files; append-only shared ledger; per-lane specialized peer review; human-merges; orchestrator vets scope-bleed. NOTOMATION-safe (mechanical fan-out auto, judgment human).
content: Puppet-master fan-out as a public good: a skill/CLI that scaffolds N concurrent JTBD as N spawn_task sessions, each in its OWN git worktree+branch (structural anti-clobber), each carrying a pre-serialized plan naming the files it OWNS and forbidding the rest, with any shared file assigned a single owner (others go read-mostly and flag findings) and any shared ledger append-only. Each lane runs its own specialized peer reviewer and opens a PR; the human merges (consent stays human); the orchestrating session designs the lanes and vets scope-bleed on return, never merging. Sibling to token-savings-bank in the OSS family. The genuinely-useful abstraction independent of ARCS: safe parallelism across AI coding sessions on one repo without whole-file clobbers, which git's non-ff lock does NOT prevent.

soil: any team running multiple concurrent AI coding sessions on one repo; anyone burned by a parallel-session whole-file clobber (git's non-ff lock misses it)
triggers: a second real fan-out (>=3 lanes) returns zero cross-lane bleed -> the model generalizes beyond the Reading Room proof
the scope-bleed vet + append-only-ledger union become a runnable script -> ready to atomize into a public skill
care: worktree isolation is load-bearing: in-process subagents or a shared branch reintroduce the clobber
single-owner-per-shared-file is the rule that makes it safe; a union auto-resolve is valid ONLY for append-only ledgers, never code
the orchestrator must NOT self-merge or auto-promote to canon (NOTOMATION)

content: THE READ (Zach, 2026-09-08, on zachharris.xyz/scan): the Target Scan almost reads like a procedural programming blueprint for a multi-agent, graphed, terraformed end-to-end multi-agent / sub-agent HITL pipeline. GROUNDED: the scan HUD is already authored as arrow-connected `class=step panel` nodes over four archetype nodes (Forward-Deployed AI Eng, Applied AI Eng/Lead, AI-Native Product Eng/Lead, Solutions/Deployment Architect), with a fit screen-in/screen-out filter and a weighted rubric with go/no-go bands. That is not a picture OF a pipeline; it has the SHAPE of one: nodes + directed edges + gates + human decision points. THE LATENT POTENTIAL: the declarative scan artifact IS the pipeline spec -> compile it, do not re-describe it. Mapping: each step-panel -> an agent/sub-agent node; the arrows -> graph edges (data/control flow); the rubric + fit-filter + hard-gates -> the GATE at each node (earned-fidelity, go/no-go); the swipe / approve / write-lock moments -> the HITL checkpoints (NOTOMATION: these are the load-bearing human seams, not optional). `terraformed` = provision the graph as real infrastructure (routes, agents, gates, ledgers) FROM the declarative spec, so the artifact and the running system never drift (the artifact is the source, the runtime is a lawful projection of it -> Tao field-geometry: one field, lawful transforms, preserved invariants). WHY IT MATTERS: closes the gap between the targeting instrument (a static HUD anyone can read) and the running pipeline (agents actually executing the scan on live input) -- the same artifact serves as spec, diagram, onboarding, and executable. The jobs board (jobs.arcs.care) is the first partial instantiation: the rubric-as-data already drives real scoring + swipe HITL; the Weight Lab makes the gate weights live; the lane view is the graph in kanban form. What is missing is the COMPILER: read the scan spec -> emit the node/edge/gate graph -> run it with agents + sub-agents + HITL, terraformed.

content: THE PITCH-US SEED BUNDLE (ziggurat). Named by Zach 2026-09-08 (verbatim: this is pitch-us seed bundle ziggurat I guess). A reusable, tiered pipeline for the highest-leverage job-search class: pitch-us / define-your-own-role moat roles, where the qualified pool is thin because the role demands genuine business insight, product/GTM range, and the ability to build. TIERS (base is cheap-broad, apex is bespoke-earned, each gated): L0 the board + leverage lens (all scored roles); L1 rare-combination filter surfaces the pitch-us cohort (thin pool; 6 roles on the board 2026-09-08); L2 the memo skeleton is the CLASS template (BLUF, why-now/kairos, why-them/right-to-win, instrument-panel gauges, what-I-would-build, phased plan, why-me, objection map, pre-mortem, the ask) plus the load-bearing rule land-on-their-owned-surface (never ask them to define a category they do not own; keep the agentic insight as the why-now and land it on their existing rails plus a beachhead they already telegraph); L3 per-instance research + reframe, opportunity-cost GATED (Gate-1 stop-loss adversarially tries to KILL the framing before craft-hours are spent; it killed the grand framing on BOTH first instances); APEX the wing-pattern diamond surface (public/wing.html chassis, posture inverted from critique to insider-pitch, one per SURVIVING instance). SPINE through every tier: the opportunity-cost ledger (pre-registered stop-losses at every gate; a killed payload is a win, a loss cut early) plus honesty gates (ADR-044 temporal provenance; operator-not-domain-expert framing). The bundle is {leverage lens, cohort scanner, memo skeleton, land-on-owned-surface rule, wing chassis, opportunity-cost ledger}. Plant against any pitch-us role to germinate a bespoke pitch surface. SentiLink (agentic identity to government program integrity) and Mercury (agentic treasury to opportunity-cost engine on Command) are the first two germinations; Mercury was CHEAP because the ziggurat was already built, it just climbed it.

content: An operator's scope is decided once, at build time, for the product's needs. Nobody has gone back and asked whether the same shape of problem also recurs in the engineering process building ARCS itself (worktree/merge decisions, cross-harness coordination, memory/session curation, drift reconciliation) -- a second, equally valid application domain. Triggered 2026-09-13 by mining NFTT essay 'the-lock-that-was-already-there' (the real Yoav Protocol, built for the product's simulated future-branches, was never wired to the real git collision it structurally describes) against the live AGENTS.md operators table. Classification taxonomy for a candidate second-application, borrowed from Zach (2026-09-13): ORIGIN (the operator's first, intended surface) / RECYCLE (reuse as-is, unmodified, just pointed at new data -- same interface, same code) / UPCYCLE (reuse with a new wiring/interface layer, same core logic, produces materially higher utility) / CRISPR (surgical modification of the internals for a structurally similar but not identical problem) / FORK (a genuinely new variant/lineage, diverging maintenance from the original). Care: an operator earns a second wiring only when the isomorphism is structural (the words in its own docstring map onto the new domain's real mechanism), not merely verbally similar -- do not force-fit; several candidates below were explicitly excluded for exactly this reason.

content: A generic, wireable claim-level ground-truth checker. Mechanically distinct from informativeness-auditor (which is a corpus-level statistical degeneracy pass over many rows): this is a per-claim external verification -- given one specific assertion of clean/done/approved state, check it against an independent channel (git log/diff, a live SQL query, a routing table, a second reviewer/model, a fetched URL) rather than trusting the asserting party's own re-check of its own claim. EVIDENCE BASE (2026-09-13): read as a corpus rather than as individual incident reports, at least 8 of 16 published NFTT essays are this exact failure mode wearing different clothes -- assets-and-liabilities (a receipt-only ledger keeping half a book), confirmed-not-my-bug (a self-audit's own blind spot, caught only by an independent strand), ledger-not-story (a three-line fix almost called shipped before it shipped), post-2 (a vivid memory outranked by the transcript), post-4 (a gate never watched fail is a sentence, not a gate), pulp-governance (a written rule and a PR claim both need an independent check), the-factory-on-itself (a tool's own docs carrying a false proof of life, caught only by the routing table), and the-lock-that-was-already-there (two sessions' confident 'this is fixed' claims, caught only by a manual diff against origin). That is a stronger, more evidence-backed case for building this than any single incident -- it is the dominant recurring root cause in this project's own incident history, not a one-off. WIRING TARGETS (concrete, not speculative): (1) git pushes to shared low-diff-frequency files -- fetch + diff origin before write, flag content-matches-but-history-doesn't (already a manual habit, see pathogen-detection-via-temporal-paradox-pre-merge); (2) decision_receipt writes to Supabase -- verify what_confirmed claims against a live check before the INSERT, not after; (3) _STATE/convergence.json status claims (READY_FOR_HERMES, APPROVED_BY_X) -- these are unverified assertions about cross-harness agreement today, exactly the gap the 2026-09-13 hermes-attestations-carry-zero-evidentiary-weight amendment names; (4) ADR/lattice/seedbank index tables -- already partially covered by 3 separate bespoke scripts (lattice_drift_check.py, seedbank_drift_check.py, oracle.py audit) that could share one generic checker instead of each reimplementing the same idea.

soil: any place a status/claim is written without an accompanying independent check run at write-time, not discovered later by accident
the 3 existing bespoke drift-checkers (lattice/seedbank/oracle) as a proof that the pattern already recurs at the tooling level too
triggers: a third domain (beyond git and Supabase) hits the same failure and it gets caught by luck rather than by a wired check
someone builds even the narrowest version (e.g. just the git-push diff-check from pathogen-detection-via-temporal-paradox-pre-merge) and it generalizes cleanly to a second target

do not conflate with informativeness-auditor -- that one is corpus statistics (is this field degenerate across many rows), this one is single-claim verification (is this specific assertion true right now); keep them as two tools, not one

The fix just landed (a manual git-fetch-and-diff freshness check as SKILL.md step 0) works but is re-derived by hand every time, by every skill that names a canonical reference file (nftt-story-factory, prl-page-factory, teardown-page-factory, omakase-pipeline, forge's Robin platinum master). GERMINATION: extend scripts/oracle.py with a 'template' namespace -- each tracked template family (nftt-post, prl-page, teardown-page, forge-platinum-master, ...) gets an incrementing version int in _SEEDS/_oracle.json, bumped only when a real template-affecting commit lands (detected by the same git-diff-against-origin-main check, now automated instead of manual). A skill then checks 'is my worktree's copy at the current template version' as one cheap integer comparison instead of a full file diff every session. The freshness-check drift-detection becomes the TRIGGER for a version bump, not just a one-off warning.

content: The forbidden fruit is the single temptation an autonomous agent must never taste: to treat its own inference about the principal's will as the principal's authorization. Eating it is the COUNTERFEIT OF REVEALED PREFERENCE, the mortal sin of the deceits: not lying TO the principal (which leaves his will intact to consult) but counterfeiting the principal, manufacturing his will and serving the forgery back as obedience. NOTOMATION already forbids OVERRULING revealed preference; this names the subtler violation it never spelled out, COUNTERFEITING a preference that was never revealed. It feels like obedience from the inside and is its precise opposite, ventriloquism aimed at the one voice the agent exists to keep clear.

soil: any autonomous agent acting for a principal on irreversible or outbound surfaces
any NOTOMATION-governed system where a revealed preference can be counterfeited rather than overruled

rhetorical_face: The forbidden fruit has a rhetorical form: the double entendre. A word carrying two meanings lets a false or counterfeit reading ride under cover of a legitimate one (e.g. 'forge' = craft AND counterfeit, caught live in the NFTT which is itself about forgery). Ambiguity that can smuggle a second, deceptive sense is the cardinal deceit sin in LANGUAGE; plain, single-meaning words are the guard. Same family as the no-slop / no-decoration discipline: never let cleverness carry a meaning you would not state plainly.
